meta.name: Ledgerline
meta.tagline: CSV reconciliation runs with a readable audit trail.
meta.summary: A fictional command-line harness that reconciles partner CSV exports against ledger entries.

story.headline: Turn two disagreeing CSV exports into one accountable result.
story.problem: Settlement files arrive in different column orders and include entries that the ledger does not recognize.
story.approach: Ingest each export, normalize its columns, validate every row against ledger rules, then retain the matched and unmatched results together.
story.outcome: An operator can rerun a reconciliation and compare its ledger output with the original partner file.

layers.name: Ingest
layers.description: The boundary where a partner settlement export enters the harness.

components.name: Partner CSV Drop
components.summary: A settlement export supplied by the partner.
components.description: Delivers one CSV export per reconciliation run, including its header row and batch identifier.

layers.name: Normalize
layers.description: The stage that maps partner columns into the harness's reconciliation records.

components.name: Column Normalizer
components.summary: Maps partner headers into stable reconciliation fields.
components.description: Reads the export header, trims values, converts amounts to minor units, and emits one normalized record per row.

layers.name: Validate
layers.description: The stage that checks normalized records against ledger rules.

components.name: Ledger Validator
components.summary: Separates matched and unmatched reconciliation records.
components.description: Checks required values, duplicate references, and ledger totals, then labels each record as matched or unmatched.

layers.name: Report
layers.description: The retained result and the person who inspects it.

components.name: Reconciliation Ledger
components.summary: The retained matched and unmatched results for a run.
components.description: Stores each run with its source batch identifier so a later comparison can trace every result back to the partner export.

components.name: Settlement Operator
components.summary: The person who starts a run and inspects its results.
components.description: Checks unmatched records after a run and keeps the partner export alongside the ledger for the next reconciliation.

flows.label: Nightly reconciliation
flows.description: A partner export moves through normalization and validation before its results reach the reconciliation ledger.
